profile.headline: Web Developer at Gwinnett County Tax Commissioner
profile.summary:
• 15+ years of experience in the Information Technology Industry in manufacturing, services, communication and academic industries.  
• Extensive experience in business analysis, project management, application development, testing and quality assurance.
• Business Analysis Experience in strategizing, modeling and implementing Rational Unified Process, across large-scale, complex business domains – with specific emphasis on Requirements Definition (Inception) using Joint Application Design (JAD) methodology, Design Modeling (Elaboration).
• Extensive Test Case Generation and Execution experience (from Use Cases and Prototypes) using Scenario Analysis and tools.
• Experience working on large, complex systems utilizing, System Life Cycle process, SDP-21 and C.M.M process.
• Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, inter-personal, teamwork skills.

positions.title: Senior VB.NET Developer at Ford Credit Co.
positions.description: Project Description: Evaluate and implement enhancement and production support requests for the Treasury Systems Global Securitization Transaction Forecasting (TF) and Investor Reporting Analysis (IRA) modules through all stages of the development cycle. Interact with key Treasury securitization and funding analysts in the U.S. and Europe to understand business requirements and implement solutions. Provide support to the TF and IRA modules to allow the Treasury business team to evaluate performance of securitized assets and to structure critical financial reports for distribution to public and private investors, rating agencies and legal counsel.

positions.title: Business Analyst/QA Tester
positions.description:
Project Description:  The Service Programming System (SPS) enables technicians to reprogram electronic modules in vehicles for the purpose of updating to more current software versions that may enhance functionality or resolve problems. Reprogram of Body, Chassis, Powertrain modules, and other modules from different vendors. SPS is part of a larger suite of applications provided to GM dealerships to reprogram vehicle modules. The software is currently used in over 50 countries and is delivered in 23 languages.

Project Description:  The Snapshot enables technicians to replay recorded vehicle data to isolate vehicle problems. Snapshot supports replaying data from Body, Chassis, and Powertrain modules, and other modules from many vendors. Snapshot is part of a larger suite of applications provided to GM dealerships to reprogram vehicle modules. The software is currently used in over 50 countries and is delivered in 23 lang

Project Description: GSIAT project is to create a new global Web-based application to replace the multiple authoring systems. This system will enable GM to support GM’s global product portfolio, joint ventures, alliances and corporate multi-branding. This will also simplify the authoring process, enable seamless data sharing and reduce the authoring costs and development time.
